whatItIs.statement: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

whenToUse.statement: Use Alert Dialog when the user must explicitly confirm or cancel an important action before continuing.

howToUse.statement: Compose AlertDialog with AlertDialogTrigger and AlertDialogContent; structure the content with Header, Title, Description, optional Media, and Footer.
Place AlertDialogCancel and AlertDialogAction in AlertDialogFooter to provide the expected response choices.

options.statement: Set size="sm" on AlertDialogContent for the smaller dialog layout; the default size is "default".
AlertDialogMedia can add an icon or image area, and AlertDialogAction accepts Button variants such as destructive.
